description: The SSE stream routes the generated kernel application registers, as (method, path template). live-view is served for @ExerisDomain(realTimeApi = true); action-stream for each @Action(streaming = true), which then has no respond-once route. {base} is DomainMetadata.effectivePath(); {action} is kebab(@Action name). StreamRouteParityE2ETest (exeris-e2e-tests) proves the generated application registers exactly these through streamRoute(...); stream-route-parity.spec.ts (exeris-codegen-ts) proves the generated TypeScript stream clients open exactly these. Change it only together with the application generator.
